Type:        DATA_WRITER
Name:        UniversalDataWriter
Category:    writers
Description: Receives data through connected input port and writes data records to delimited or fixed length files based on input metadata. This component is alias for FlatFileWriter.
Usage:       Use to write records to flat files in CSV, fixed-length, or mixed-length formats, including remote targets, compressed outputs, partitioned files, output ports, or dictionaries. It is the UniversalDataWriter alias of FlatFileWriter, so it is the standard choice for generic flat-file export.

Input Ports:
  [0] (required)
Output Ports:
  [0] (optional)

Properties:
  Always required:
    fileURL

  fileURL: [file] (REQUIRED)  Specifies the path or URL of the file to process. This is the primary attribute that determines which file will be processed by the component.
  charset: [charset]  Defines the character encoding used to encode/decode file content. If not specified, the system will attempt to detect or use the default encoding.
  append: [bool]  (default: false)  When enabled, appends data to the existing output file instead of overwriting it.
  quotedStrings: [bool]  Enables parsing of quoted string values in delimited files, allowing strings to contain delimiter characters.
  quoteCharacter: [writerQuoteChar]  Specifies the character used to quote string values in delimited files when quoted strings are enabled.
  makeDirs: [bool]  (default: false)  When enabled, automatically creates the necessary directory structure if it doesn't exist.
  outputFieldNames: [bool]  (default: false)  When enabled, writes field names as the first line in the output file, creating a header row.
  recordsPerFile: [int]  Limits the number of records written to each output file before creating a new file.
  bytesPerFile: [int]  Limits the size of each output file in bytes before creating a new file.
  recordSkip: [int]  Specifies the number of records to skip before starting to write data to the output file.
  recordCount: [int]  Limits the maximum number of records to write to the output file.
  excludeFields: [key]  Specifies which fields from the input should be excluded from the output.
  partitionKey: [key] (required when partition is set)  Defines the key fields used to partition data into separate output files based on field values.
  partition: [lookupTableID] (required when partitionOutFields is set)  Specifies the lookup table used for partitioning data into different output files.
  partitionFileTag: [enum]  (default: Number file tag)  Determines how output files are named when partitioning is used.
    values: numberFileTag, keyNameFileTag
  partitionOutFields: [key] (required when partition is set)  Specifies which fields from the partition lookup table are used in the output.
  partitionUnassignedFileName: [string]  Specifies the filename for records that don't match any partition criteria.
  sortedInput: [bool]  (default: false)  Indicates whether the input data is already sorted, which can optimize processing performance.
  createEmptyFiles: [bool]  (default: true)  When enabled, creates empty output files even when no data is available to write.
  skipLastRecordDelimiter: [bool]  (default: false)  When enabled, omits the record delimiter after the last record in the output file.

To configure it, call component_get_guide("DATA_WRITER") — full attribute reference with allowed values, defaults, and worked mapping/transform examples this surface view omits. Don't re-run component_get_info on the same type; if the properties above aren't enough, escalate to component_get_guide.
